description: One match of a regular expression, returned by match() and match_all(): the text matched, where it starts, and the text of each group by number and by name.

captures.description: The text of each group by number: captures[0] is the whole match (the same as match) and captures[n] is group n, as $n is in a replacement. An entry is undefined when its group did not take part in the match.
captures.label: Captures

groups.description: The text of each named group, by name, in the order of the groups in the pattern. A named group that did not take part in the match has no property. Absent when the regular expression has no named groups.
groups.label: Groups

index.brief: Code point index of the match
index.description: The zero-based code point index in the value where the match starts.
index.label: Index

match.description: The text of the whole match.
match.label: Match
